videos.script: Lesson 7 chose among Gemini models. This is the API behind them, through Google's own library. {{shape}} Contents made of parts, a role called model, and a system instruction that lives in the configuration. The library writes it all in camel case on the wire. {{structured}} Give it a class, and it sends a schema and hands back a parsed object, counted before it was sent. {{text-none}} And one property to treat with care: the text of a response can be None. Read why it stopped before you read what it said.
